include: experiment project metadata and light artifacts

required_steps: measure tracked file count and total tracked size
identify the heaviest tracked directories and files
classify each hotspot as canonical truth or removable/generated residue
repair artifact-boundary violations before discussing a repo split
record the outcome as keep_monorepo, keep_monorepo_with_cleanup, or split_candidate
escalation_rule: Only escalate to split_candidate after cleanup and externalization options were evaluated and found insufficient.
